title: /groups/invite returns 2.04 Changed even when record_invitation silently drops document
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_invite.py:60-66 discards record_invitation bool; expired-beyond-local-clock/bad-node cases yield CHANGED with nothing recorded; client discovers later as opaque 4.03 at join_key. Return 4.03 declined per spec 18.8.2 response semantics.
close_reason: Fixed: groups_invite propagates record_invitation False as 4.03 Forbidden instead of 2.04 Changed, and only appends accepted invitations after successful recording. Tests: test_groups_invite_replay.py::test_clock_skew_returns_declined_not_changed (server-clock-past expiry declined with aligned-clock contrast case returning CHANGED) and ::test_unknown_group_document_returns_declined.
